title: SRE & Data Quality — Zenika Platform
description: Historique des triages SRE automatiques, tendances Data Quality (ValidationError), sévérités et FinOps du triage.

panels.title: 🔴 Triages CRITICAL (7j)
panels.description: Nombre de triages SRE classifiés CRITICAL sur les 7 derniers jours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNTIF(severity = 'CRITICAL') as value FROM `${project}.finops_$env.sre_triage_history` WHERE triggered_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND env = '$env'

panels.title: ⚠️ DQ Errors total (7j)
panels.description: Total des ValidationError détectées par tous les triages sur 7 jours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(dq_errors_count) as value FROM `${project}.finops_$env.sre_triage_history` WHERE triggered_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND env = '$env'

panels.title: 💰 Coût IA Triage (7j)
panels.description: Coût total estimé des triages LLM sur 7 jours en USD.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost_usd), 4) as value FROM `${project}.finops_$env.sre_triage_history` WHERE triggered_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND env = '$env'

panels.title: 📊 Taux de santé (7j)
panels.description: Pourcentage de triages classifiés OK sur 7 jours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(COUNTIF(severity = 'OK') * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) as value FROM `${project}.finops_$env.sre_triage_history` WHERE triggered_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND env = '$env'

panels.title: 📈 Sévérité des triages dans le temps
panels.description: Distribution CRITICAL / WARNING / OK par triage, triée chronologiquement.

targets.rawSql: SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(triggered_at, HOUR) as time, COUNTIF(severity='CRITICAL') as critical, COUNTIF(severity='WARNING') as warning, COUNTIF(severity='OK') as ok FROM `${project}.finops_$env.sre_triage_history` WHERE triggered_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND env = '$env' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 🧪 Data Quality — ValidationError par triage
panels.description: Nombre de ValidationError détectées à chaque triage. Une hausse indique une migration manquante ou une rupture de contrat Pydantic.

targets.rawSql: SELECT triggered_at as time, dq_errors_count as dq_errors, total_5xx as erreurs_5xx FROM `${project}.finops_$env.sre_triage_history` WHERE triggered_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND env = '$env' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 📋 Derniers rapports SRE
panels.description: Les 20 derniers triages avec sévérité, DQ errors, 5xx et résumé exécutif.

targets.rawSql: SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', triggered_at, 'Europe/Paris') as horodatage, severity as sévérité, dq_errors_count as dq_errors, total_5xx as erreurs_5xx, ROUND(cost_usd, 5) as coût_usd, CASE playbook_used WHEN TRUE THEN '✅' ELSE '❌' END as playbook, CASE followup_scheduled WHEN TRUE THEN '⚡' ELSE '' END as followup, LEFT(report_excerpt, 200) as résumé FROM `${project}.finops_$env.sre_triage_history` WHERE env = '$env' ORDER BY triggered_at DESC LIMIT 20
